description: Takes loads out of the model without touching other load cases: CIVIL NX keeps every case's beam loads, nodal loads, pressures and temperatures of an element or node in ONE row, so a plain delete would take the other cases with it — this tool rewrites each row with the items that stay. loads [{ case, on | at (optional selection; default everywhere), kinds (optional: nodal, udl, pressure, temperature, gradient, selfWeight) }] removes that case's loads; deleteCases [names] removes the cases' loads and then the load cases themselves; supports { at }, springs { at }, releases { on } remove those at the selected nodes / elements. Selections as in civil_loads_supports. Previews what goes (counts per kind, rows touched, combinations that would lose a case); apply: true with confirmPlanHash. civil_write_tables_undo puts everything back, load cases included.

deleteCases.description: Load cases to delete, with all their loads.

at.description: Which nodes. Start set: group (structure group name), nodes, elements — given together they intersect; none = the whole model. Then filters (coordinates in the input length unit): line { from, to } (on that segment), box { min, max }, where { x: 0 } or { z: [0, 2] }, type (BEAM, TRUSS, PLATE…), pick xmin|xmax|ymin|ymax|zmin|zmax (the extreme nodes, e.g. the ends of a girder group). An element passes a geometric filter when all its nodes do. tol default 0.001.
